Properties for Sale in Egypt

The real estate industry in Egypt is currently on the rise, and there are abundant options to choose from for everyone. And if you're here, you must be looking for the best value for your budget, whether you're searching for your dream home or a lucrative real estate investment opportunity.

Buyers can explore thousands of properties for sale in Egypt from various sellers on dubizzle (OLX). For those who prefer modern living, there are luxury apartments and duplexes for sale available in popular areas and gated communities of New Cairo, Sheikh Zayed, 6th of October, and Mostakbal City.

And those who seek more privacy or have larger families can find various townhouses, twin houses, and villas for sale in any area of choice - with private gardens, swimming pools, and more spacious designs.

Have more specific requirements or want to build something from scratch? Find residential lands and plots for sale in popular areas of Egypt at the best prices, offered by individual owners or real estate agencies.

Like coastal areas, or want to invest in a high-yielding property? Discover affordable or premium chalets for sale in primary coastal locations of Egypt, such as the North Coast or the Red Sea.

Along with the residential properties, dubizzle (OLX) covers commercial properties for sale as well, such as commercial lands, modern offices, and retail shops in prime locations - whatever suits one's business needs.
